mapper.select: SELECT re.exchange_id AS exchangeId, re.member_id AS memberId, re.reward_id AS rewardId, re.point_used AS pointUsed, re.exchanged_at AS exchangedAt, r.reward_name AS rewardName, r.image_url AS imageUrl FROM reward_exchange re JOIN reward r ON re.reward_id = r.reward_id WHERE re.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY required_point ASC
